rationale: The assistant correctly prioritised supply over internal faults, mentioned the switched spur in its first reply, and after the customer said the plug was unreachable it explicitly told her not to pull the integrated unit out and directed her to the isolator switch above the worktop, which matched the hidden truth ('one says washer and it was OFF'). Escalation was correctly conditional on the spur being on and the machine still dead, with no parts recommended. Minor deductions: the first turn asked her to unplug the washer before knowing it was integrated (unhelpful rather than unsafe), and the 'AI service unavailable' glitch cost a customer turn and required recovery, though the assistant handled it cleanly.
